item.tib: 'jigs byed gshin rje khros pa'i gsang rgyud dug mtsho khol ma las byung ba'i las rim phung byed nag po lag tu len pa'i phyag bzhes rdo rje'i phreng ba
item.coloph: ces 'jigs byed gshin rje'i gsang rgyud dug mtsho khol ma las byung bsnyen sgrub las sbyor lag tu len thabs 'di nyid snga nas rgyal sras pad+ma phrin las mchog nas rab dkar cod pan bcas 'di ltar 'bri dgos zhes bskal ma gnang yang btang snyoms su nar 'gyang gyur skabs/ rgyal sras bstan 'dzin tshul khrims dpal bzang po nas a she rgya dar dri med dang 'bri gzhi shog bu bcas yang nan bka' lji phebs bzhin/ de rnams kyi slob 'bangs su gtogs pa'i spa rigs dge sbyong g.yung drung bstan pa 'brug grags pa des sa yos 'bras ldan zla ba'i dkar phyogs dga' ba dang po'i tshes bzang por sug bris bgyis pas rgyal ba mnyam med gshen rab mi bo'i bstan pa rin po che phyogs dus kun tu dar zhing rgyas pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig sarba yan+tu/ mang+ga lam//
